items.memory: The backup job kestrel-snapshot copies the queue database every 6 hours, and each copy is kept for 30 days in the cold-storage bucket kestrel-archive.
A restore drill runs on the first Monday of every month, and the on-call engineer records the restore duration in the drill log.
